title: Muttering Mollusk
statement: A small, rust-colored octopus sits among a dozen smooth pebbles it has arranged, rearranged, and rearranged again, occasionally lifting one to inspect it with quiet suspicion before setting it down a single centimeter to the left. The water around it is warm and tea-dark, lit by a soft amber glow, as though the whole tank is a study where someone is very nearly finished editing a sentence they wrote hours ago.
